title: Oozy Spicy Japanese Bryndza Cheese Miso Ramen
description: A spicy and fluffy lacto-vegetarian ramen dish featuring bryndza cheese and Japanese miso, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Bring the vegetable broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add the sake, mirin, and gochujang to the pot and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Cook the ramen noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
In a small bowl, whisk together the miso paste and 2 tablespoons of hot water until smooth.
Add the miso mixture to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the crumbled bryndza cheese to the pot and stir until melted and smooth.
Add the cooked ramen noodles to the pot and stir to combine.
Transfer the ramen to a bowl and top with green onions and a drizzle of sesame oil.
Immediately submerge the bowl in an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
Serve the oozy spicy Japanese bryndza cheese miso ramen hot.
